tasks.check: deno fmt --check src scripts tests examples docs .github README.md ASSET-ATTRIBUTION.md deno.json package.json tsconfig.build.json tsconfig.core.json && deno lint src scripts tests && deno run --allow-read --allow-env npm:typescript@5.9.3/tsc --project tsconfig.core.json && deno run --allow-read --allow-env npm:typescript@5.9.3/tsc --project tsconfig.build.json --noEmit && deno check tests/unit/*.ts tests/conformance/*.ts tests/browser/*.ts tests/package/*.ts scripts/*.ts
tasks.test:browser: deno task build && deno test --allow-read --allow-write --allow-env --allow-sys --allow-run --allow-net=127.0.0.1 tests/browser
tasks.test:package: deno task build && deno test --allow-read --allow-write=.build --allow-run --allow-env tests/package
tasks.test:all: deno task check && deno task test && deno task test:fixtures && deno task test:browser && deno task test:package
tasks.example: deno task build && deno run --allow-read=dist,examples,assets --allow-net=127.0.0.1:8000 scripts/serve.ts
